title: My EKODI Operator Hub Boundary
principles: https://ekodi.kr/my/ is an operator-personalized hub for EKODI super administrators, deputy operators, service owners, and delegated site administrators; it is not a mandatory destination for ordinary end users.

Ordinary users remain inside the brand context of the site they are using. EKODI identity may be created and used for authentication, authorization, consent, profile, notifications, billing, AI, and shared-service delivery without forcing navigation through My EKODI.

My EKODI summarizes operator-specific tasks, approvals, alerts, health, recent activity, and authorized administration destinations. It must not duplicate the source-of-truth management UI of each site.
My EKODI displays only administration destinations and operational information already authorized to the signed-in person. My EKODI does not grant, infer, or elevate privileges.
Each tenant or user-operated site keeps its own brand, language, and contextual user experience. EKODI platform branding is not forced into ordinary user flows.
Legacy my.ekodi.kr remains compatibility-only and must not be reintroduced as a public canonical entry point.
